notes: Start: p. 63 row 5 (after Spell 147 end 'χer - k'); p. 63 footnote 1 (Var. ... Bd. I., Bl. 166) belongs to Spell 147, ignored. End: p. 66 row 6 after 'Semati'; '1. t'etet ...' following belongs to pylon 7. p. 65 actually has NINE printed rows, not 7: the '(sic)' rows are rows 1 and 9 and the dotted English is in row 9 (the brief's 'row 7'). Overlines: every pylon opening is overlined from t'etet through àn (the overline ends just over àn's water-line; for pylons 1 and 2 this includes t'et and àn, before Àusàr), except pylon 3 where the overline covers t'etet...ent (rows 7-8 of p. 64) and a separate short overline is printed over àn alone (no t'et). Pylon 1's sebχet determinative is a tall narrow tower; pylons 2-6 use an L-shaped building with uraeus-like frieze. Lines: sebχet split by '2.' in pylon 2 (kept line 1); Ani split by numerals (kept first-sign line). Bracketed signs: p.64 r5 neb[X1], r6 nebt [X1] (transliteration unbracketed), r7 Mes-Ptaḥ [Q3 X1]; p.65 r2 [D21]; p.66 r4 [Z1] in àu ḥefu and the whole θennu group bracketed. Flat curled sign coded D36 where Budge reads ā (āa, āāau, āāat, āāt, Ārqiu) and U15 elsewhere. Signature mark 'K' printed at foot of p. 65. Page 66 header reads 'Plate XII.' but the plate heading 'PLATE XII.' comes later.
